scope: Corrections to the same address_points geometry vertical slice only; no additional transform group is authorized

required_spec_binding.validation: The running checkpoint must load the reviewed transform specification and fail if the group, implementation unit, callable binding, covered fields, context fields or target entity differ

required_lineage_resolution.source_record_lookup: Resolve proposed_source_record from source_key='address_points:' || current_source.address_points.id; do not hard-code the source_record_id
required_lineage_resolution.evidence_lookup: Resolve exactly one proposed_evidence_object through the resolved source_record_id; do not hard-code the evidence_object_id
required_lineage_resolution.exception_source_key: Derive the migration-exception source_key from the queried source row

precision_case.rule: Do not round or format source coordinates to a fixed number of decimal places before PostGIS insertion

required_comparator_boundary.rule: The comparator must query all rows attributable to this source slice and compare expected and observed sets in both directions

required_failure_state_proof.rule: Do not reset or recreate the database before proving the failed test left authoritative target state unchanged
